description: 경기도_터널 방재시설 현황 [roads, bridges and tunnels and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 경기도. 이 데이터는 경기도에 위치한 터널 방재시설 현황에 대한 자료로 터널 위치, 길이, 높이 등 터널에 대한 기본 정보와 소화전, 긴급전화, CCTV, 비상조명 등 터널에 설치된 방재시설에. Coverage: 경기도. The portal files it under the publisher 경기도. Its tags are 터널, 지하차도, 방재시설, 재난예방, 안전관리. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-05-15 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
